gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans keeps its strokes light but visibly varied, with c tips that stop well short of touching. And Comic Relief goes the other way, a bold display face with uniform strokes and bowls left unfinished on one side.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tirra: Tirra is a sans-serif with round forms like open parentheses. Comic Relief sits above it, bold and commanding, with unfinished bowls and no pinched joints, so the two feel like a shout and a murmur.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow reads as a tidy sans whose bowls open like a cupped palm. Beside it, Comic Relief feels loud and heavy-handed, its tails and terminals as thick as its stems, while Tomorrow stays low-key.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-plein: Spaghetti-line looks, bold and expressive: that is Funnel Display, every stroke one constant width you could trace with a finger. Plein follows in a plain sans, with a clear channel leading into each round letter, and it keeps a long page moving steadily.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads as approachable and contemporary, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and a moderate lowercase height. Funnel Display above it is the tall, expressive one, so a long passage feels easy going.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-allerta: Bent-pipe strokes of constant width give Funnel Display its expressive, commanding look. But Allerta, a plain sans with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height, lets a long passage unfold without any fuss.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display holds its strokes at constant width from stem to curve. Alumni Sans SC does the opposite job as a plain sans, with squeezed letterspacing, oversized lowercase and bowls that swell only slightly.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arsenal: Funnel Display draws curves as heavy as its stems, like cord. Arsenal, a plain sans with a close-knit texture and a faint nib-pressure shift in each round letter, gives that cord-like heading a quieter, approachable partner underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arsenal-sc: Cord-like and commanding, Funnel Display draws its bowls at stem thickness, which is what it does best. Arsenal SC is the fine-grained one, a sans-serif with a faint thick-thin shift and tight fit between characters.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-basic: Ruler-straight lines and a commanding, expressive streak define Funnel Display, with constant-width strokes throughout. Basic is its clean, professional plain sans counterpart, whose gentle bump from small letters to capitals is its quiet strength.
